body:

Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560, project run by the Sales account, `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and labels are triage's.

**Who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat 1, by a sub-agent (one PR).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Installed Apps, the system administrator.
- **Now:** the nav item "Installed Apps" opens a page titled "Packages" whose empty state reads "No packages match your filters." The title disagrees with the nav, and the empty state blames a filter the administrator did not set.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm round 1 track 2 report U-06 and `sweep-05-installed-apps.png`, re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by round 2 (links on objectstack-ai/objectstack#25334).

## Landing (read on objectui `origin/main` `2c4e5f5`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`: the header title is `t('engine.packages.title')` (~:1452) and the empty state falls to `t('engine.packages.emptyFiltered')` (~:1580); strings in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`'Packages'`, `'No packages match your filters.'`, and the zh pack).
- The component is registered as `developer:packages` (`packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`); `packageSource.ts` reads the source. The dev measures whether the page sees `params.source === 'marketplace'` from the Installed Apps entry. If it does not, and objectstack must pass something new, stop and report: that half is a `domain:cli` card of its own with `Blocked-by:` on this one (the cli seat's comment on #25334 says so).
- Serial: objectstack-ai/objectstack#25098 (open, blocked) reshapes Setup's Apps group and keeps this Installed Apps door. Read it before claiming.

## Done when

- Opened from Installed Apps (`source: 'marketplace'`), the page is titled "Installed Apps".
- With nothing installed from the marketplace and no filter set, it says "No apps installed from the marketplace yet", not that filters match nothing. "No packages match your filters" stays only when a filter is actually set.
- Setup → Packages (no `source`) is unchanged.
- Translated in the shipped locales; pinned in the page's tests.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectui issue updated since 2026-10-15 (236, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint at 2026-10-23T11:45Z, matched case-insensitively on titles. Words: `installed apps`, `marketplace`, `packages page`, `developer:packages`. 1 hit, closed: #12943 (an app-shell spec floor raise). Not on point. **New.**
